source_lines.text: sha() { if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1"; else shasum -a 256 "$1"; fi | cut -d' ' -f1; }
sums() {  # DIR NAME...: each NAME's kind, and its files' SHA-256, in order
if [ -d "$x" ]; then echo "dir $x"; find "$x" -type f | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do echo "$f $(sha "$f")"; done
[ "$(sums "$S" $names)" = "$(sums "$V" $names)" ] || { echo "restore: $V is not as saved in $S" >&2; exit 1; }
